title: Relationships
tagline: Build relationships naturally and organically in a world where every character is unique
description:
Relationships allows you to establish and build relationships in a way that feels natural and organic in a SkyrimNet-driven world. Every character has a unique combination of traits and attributes that make them behave and react to you in their own way.

Some characters fall deeply in love but want to save themselves for marriage, while others shun commitment but are open to dating with no strings attached. Getting to know them and treating them accordingly is the whole point, just as in real life. Settings give you control over how quickly relationships progress. Relationships can also regress as warranted.

This applies to both romantic and platonic relationships. Deciding to progress to a romantic relationship requires mutual consent. A successful marriage proposal requires progressing to the highest tier.

Optionally integrates with its companion mod Kinship, so your significant other(s) and children are aware of their relationships to one another and act accordingly. Settings can ensure that your children are blocked from having romantic relations but can still grow their platonic bond.

Requires:
- SkyrimNet Beta 25+
- SKSE64
- Address Library for SKSE Plugins
- PapyrusUtil SE
- powerofthree's Papyrus Extender
- Papyrus MessageBox (Nexus 83578; required for the consent prompt; bundled by MARAS)

Optionally supports:
- Kinship ( for awareness of familial ties )
- M.A.R.A.S. ( for marriage )
- OStim Community Resource ( for attractiveness rating )
- SeverActions ( for custom bio blocks )
- Merdian UI (non-VR users only)
- Prisma UI

Contains no adult content.
author: deadohiosky
changelog:
**People can turn against you now.** Below Stranger there's Disliked, Resentful and Enemy. Treat someone badly and they cool on you a bit at a time. Break the promise your whole relationship rested on and it drops at once, though never past Resentful in one go. Keep it up after that and they'll get to Enemy. A Resentful wife tells you to your face she wants you gone; she doesn't reach for a knife.

**Witnesses count.** Mistreat someone in front of your partner and your partner judges it too. Someone who storms off mid-argument still gets judged for what was said.

**Making up takes a while.** Someone you've hurt can come round, but it's about twice as slow as the fall. Back at zero with someone you used to be close to, they're Estranged, not a stranger.

**Characters get more bio blocks.** With SeverActions 4.3.0, enrolling a character in Relationships includes automatic selection and application of several custom bio blocks based on the character's existing information. Anything you select yourself is left alone. Turn it off with Choose Other Bio Blocks in the plugin settings if you prefer to not use them or to only set them manually.

Block changes land straight away, and Drawn To, Expression, Attachment and Appetite allow only one block each since the options are mutually exclusive within those tabs.

**Re-authoring keeps how someone's changed.** It used to wipe out what they'd drifted into.

The dashboard shows the bad side too, and the background judges no longer read anyone's inventory.
